highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and improves WebAssembly compatibility, rendering performance, and hot-path efficiency.
highlights_body: It adds .NET 11 WebAssembly assets, restores fast CPU rasterization for scaled and tiled bitmaps, and reduces overhead in color and text processing. SKColor hex parsing is stricter, so review the breaking change before upgrading.

breaking.title: SKColor hex parsing rejects whitespace after the hash
breaking.body: SKColor.Parse and TryParse no longer accept whitespace immediately after '#' in six- or eight-digit forms. Remove that whitespace before parsing; leading and trailing whitespace around the complete value remains supported.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled rendering engine from Skia m150 to m151 while retaining the existing C and managed binding surfaces.

bullets.lead: Span-based parsing added for colors and font tags
bullets.detail: Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> Parse overloads for SKColor, SKFourByteTag, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag, plus a span-based SKColor.TryParse overload, so callers can parse slices without creating substrings.
Restores the legacy shader context used by optimized CPU blitters, addressing high CPU usage, dropped frames, and flicker when scaling or tiling bitmaps.
Includes the upstream SubRunAllocator lifetime fix that prevents a use-after-free, wild free, or double free when a corrupt Slug buffer fails to deserialize.

bullets.lead: Ganesh stencil and resolve handling corrected
bullets.detail: Includes upstream fixes for stencil clearing with kPreserve, native-coordinate clear tracking, and dirty tracking after a resolve task fails.
Moves SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiplication and unpremultiplication to managed math, avoiding native transitions while preserving exact results.
Uses pooled UTF-8 encoding in HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) and reads SKShaper glyph results through spans, reducing allocations on text-shaping hot paths.
SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) now deterministically disposes the intermediate full-size image when Subset returns a separate image.
Ships Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 and compiles them with the matching exnref exception model, preventing link failures and mixed-exception runtime compilation errors.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: .NET 11 WebAssembly native-asset support and upstream WebAssembly build cleanup

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.summary: Opens the 4.151 line with the Skia m151 engine update.

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.summary: Tightens SKColor hex parsing, so remove whitespace immediately after '#'. Adds span-based color and tag parsing, speeds HarfBuzzSharp text ingestion and SKShaper glyph extraction, and fixes corrupt Slug deserialization.

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.summary: Adds .NET 11 WebAssembly assets with compatible exception handling, restores CPU bitmap rasterization performance, and accelerates color conversion. Fixes an intermediate image leak and includes Ganesh stencil and resolve corrections.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 uses pooled UTF-8 encoding in Buffer.AddUtf8(string) and adds Tag.Parse(ReadOnlySpan<char>) with direct, allocation-conscious tag parsing.
